column3: Resume is approval-marker-based, not frontier-region-scoped
The determinism scope is unimplemented.
The scheduler does not yet consume delta signatures end to end.
`smelt explain` does not yet print the delta-signature headline
A `contract.cells[].deferral` cell addressing a strict subset of the plain fold's own column groups cannot decline the fold's whole-row write.
`diff_patch` over the region `DeleteInsert` default has a runtime lowering for the membership-sensitive (`grain: key`, `UpstreamMutation`-triggered) case only
Emission remainders
The ledger's warehouse substrate is DuckDB-only
Graph-layer gaps
Delta detection for `--since-upstream` is explicit-only in v1
Straddle attribution without locality is scoped out of the ledger's v1
The derived model-wide horizon is under construction
A `change_feed` source's mutation cell always re-derives from the full input
Conditional-maintenance gaps
Per-column `data_latency` is unimplemented
Non-deterministic row-set-membership or grouping is out of scope
Schema evolution on the partition grain is largely a definition delta now
The `PartitionGrainForbidsMetrics` refusal is unimplemented
The sub-`g_part` rejection does not yet name the coarsened window
`NOW()`/`CURRENT_*` are still compile-time-pinned
The once-write classifier has no nullability route around the fallback case
The reconciliation ledger's fold — additive-graded and re-run-tolerant alike — is transactional, and the ledger table itself exists, on DuckDB only (Open Question)
`smelt explain` prints neither the per-column guarantee ledger nor the derivable forward reach (Open Question)
Key temporal locality route 2 admits only a declared functional dependency (Open Question)
Locality machinery gaps
Order-independence is not yet acted on
The pattern-function template file does not exist
`NOW()`/`CURRENT_*` are still rejected in keyed models
Ladder rungs 3–4 remain specified ahead of this profile's use of them
The `key_per_partition` grain derives no plan
Several declared proofs have no consumer wired yet.
`EffectiveWindow` and `BoundResult` remain two separate walks (Open Question).
The composition walk is not yet the sole source of every property.
Declared source lateness reaches no live scan today (Open Question)
`cumulative.rs`'s whole-SQL window-function admission scan is not yet classified onto the walk
`INTERSECT`/`EXCEPT` are unclassified for filter distribution
Additive-only model-diff can't detect a semantic change under an unchanged expression (Open Question)
Skeleton-source closure v1 is restricted to non-aggregating enrichment scopes (Open Question)
Only one maintenance-cell route consults a declared-RI closure today
Fingerprint projection (P4) has no consumer yet
The append-only posture probe does not consult declared lateness
`SourceUniqueKeyViolated` remains the one probe-registry row with no emitter at all (Open Question)
Output-delta shape is derived, typed onto propagation edges, and acted on by dirt propagation, but the keyed dirt-set remains symbolic.
The grammar boundary between `columns.<c>.contract` and a future column `tests:` block is deliberately deferred (Open Question)
